title: 美国中期选举结果出炉 能源议题成焦点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's kick off and hello and welcome everybody.
segments.zh: 我们开始吧，大家好，欢迎各位。

segments.en: Good morning from Washington, DC. I'm here in the Washington offices of Bloomberg with my colleague, Derek Flagel.
segments.zh: 早上好，我在华盛顿特区彭博办公室，和同事德里克·弗拉格尔一起。

segments.en: I'm directly across the way from here. And welcome to this SNAP Bloomberg NEF webinar, where we're going to look to talk about the results of last night's election.
segments.zh: 我就在对面。欢迎参加SNAP彭博NEF网络研讨会，我们将讨论昨晚选举结果。

segments.en: Before we get going just a quick housekeeping note, which is that we are going to record this webinar for later consumption on dnef.com for clients.
segments.zh: 开始前快速提醒：本次研讨会将录制，供客户在dnef.com回看。

segments.en: And we're not going to take questions. It's going to be a pretty quick session, hopefully about 35, 40 minutes.
segments.zh: 我们不设问答环节，会议约35到40分钟。

segments.en: You know, a lot of folks have a lot of thoughts on their mind. And hopefully we'll cover kind of the most important topics overall in our conversation.
segments.zh: 很多人有很多想法，希望我们能在对话中覆盖最重要的主题。

segments.en: So, Derek, wow, what a night.
segments.zh: 德里克，哇，昨晚真是精彩。

segments.en: I think the size and the scope of the blowout for Democrats was really enormous.
segments.zh: 民主党大胜的规模和范围确实巨大。

segments.en: And unprecedented, as far as I know, at least in this century, let's say, for Democrats in terms of Democratic wins.
segments.zh: 据我所知，至少在本世纪，民主党的胜利前所未有。

segments.en: And so next year, Democrats will control both the House as was expected of representatives.
segments.zh: 明年，民主党将如预期控制众议院。
